findings.comment: Trees are shown on the electrical plan (Sheet 21) with canopy symbols overlapping or within less than 10 lateral feet of transformer pads (notably Pad 1 where canopy completely overlaps the pad). These trees are not identified by tree number from the surveyed tree list (Sheet 32), and therefore their species and utility-compatibility status per ECM Appendix F cannot be verified from the submitted plans. Cross-reference tree locations on the electrical plan with surveyed tree numbers and confirm species are listed in ECM Appendix F Utility Compatible column.

Underground water (W), wastewater (WW), and storm drain (SD) utility lines are shown on the electrical plan routing near and crossing transformer pad locations. However, no minimum separation distances (12-inch minimum horizontal and vertical per UCM § 1.10.5.A) are dimensioned on the plans. Clearances cannot be verified from available evidence. Provide dimensioned details on utility plans showing minimum 12-inch separation from transformer pads to all underground utilities.

No transformer easements are shown around any of the three transformer pads on the electrical plan. Transformer easements with specified width for Austin Energy accessibility requirements are required around all pads. Provide easement designations (e.g., 'Electrical Transformer Easement' or 'AE Access Easement') with width dimensions determined by Austin Energy Design, shown on site plan and/or electrical plan.

Transformer pads are shown on the electrical plan as simple rectangles with no dimensions, specifications, or detail sheet references. No callouts referencing Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets for the specified service type (single-phase or three-phase) are provided. Service type and pad dimensions must match AE Design specifications. Provide transformer pad dimensions (e.g., '8 ft x 10 ft') and reference AE Design-approved equipment pad detail sheets with appropriate detail number and specifications for each pad.

applicableAreas: Transformer Pad 2 (north-central interior, adjacent to parking)
findings.comment: Transformer Pad 2 is located 0.6 feet (approximately 7 inches) from the nearest parking curb/surface, well within the 4-foot threshold requiring protective bollards. No bollards are shown on the electrical plan. Install 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal bollards per AE Design equipment pad details, spaced to allow equipment door access. Provide bollard locations, spacing, and specifications on electrical plan and equipment detail sheets.
